card.name: Spans of past time in history
card.fires_on: Numbers and nearby words in descriptions of how long ago something began or how old it is, such as 35 million years or dates back to 6000 BC. It also fires on words in historical-origin passages.

modes.label: Large ages and dates
modes.description: Digits or magnitude words inside ages or ancient dates, just before years or BC.
modes.example: Roses are believed to be 35<< million>> years old.

modes.label: Early history phrasing
modes.description: Words in sentences about origins, ancient peoples or the long past.
modes.example: Their historical areas of<< settlement>> were on the Iranian plateau

card.writes: It pushes toward words about years elapsed and remembering the past, and away from ancestor words.
card.plain: It lights up when text talks about how many years ago something happened or how old something is.
evidence: Roses are believed to be 35<< million>> years old.
Human habitation in Prague dates back around<< >>6000 BC.
